ValidationRule.description: Only enable BDR Role to create opp with status as Qualification
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.Bypass_VR__c = FALSE, CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'BDR Role'), Addressable_Merchant_Revenue_Monthly_USD__c >= 500, OR( AND( ISNEW(), NOT( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Qualification") ) ) , AND( !ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Qualification"), ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Lost") ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: BDR only be able to update opportunity with stage as "Qualification"
